description: Saylor Innovations is a digital services firm that designs, builds, and hosts custom websites for small businesses across the United States. Their offerings include rapid website development (most builds live in three weeks), automation solutions, and AI integration to streamline business processes. They also provide a product called Propz, a tip‑jar platform that enables creators to receive direct on‑chain payments via Solana or Base networks, charging a transparent 1 % platform fee. The company focuses on delivering high‑quality, scalable web experiences while empowering creators with modern payment tools.
